programs.title: Dil Tera Aashiq
programs.desc: Thakur Ranvir Singh Chaudhary cuts off his ties with his sister after she marries a man below their status, but after her death the responsibility of looking after her children falls on him.

programs.title: Babu
programs.desc: Babu, a young man, falls in love with Kammo. When a thug rapes her, he murders him out of revenge, which leads to his arrest. After his release, he starts looking after Kammo and her child, Pinky. However, Pinky grows up to be a snob.

programs.title: Saagar
programs.desc: Raja, a fisherman is secretly in love with Mona. When wealthy Ravi comes to live with his grandmother, Kamladevi, he sees Mona and falls in love with her.

programs.title: Aadmi 1993
programs.desc: Vijay, a factory supervisor, is falsely accused and arrested for killing his family. Just when he is at his lowest point, an inspector offers to help him in return for capturing the son of a gangster.

programs.title: Aa Gale Lag Jaa 1994
programs.desc: Roshni, a wealthy heiress, wants to marry Suraj, a poor man, but her mother disapproves as his father is an ex-prisoner. Meanwhile, a series of murders take place and the suspicion falls on Suraj.

programs.title: Aapas Ki Baat
programs.desc: Kajal and Anand are two lovers who are separated when Kajal's family refuses to accept their relationship. Years later, fate brings them face-to-face with each other.
